cases.description: The task requires a simulator recipe during preparation. The selected sandbox profile starts only the gateway; the offered companion profile prepares the simulator on this slot.
The current task validates gateway RPC only. The issue mentions a future mobile follow-up, but no simulator evidence is required in this run. The selected sandbox profile prepares the gateway.
The proposed profile prepares Companion alongside the gateway. No acceptance criteria or proof plan are available for the task.

The task requires validating Command Center and a mobile recipe against one checkout. The selected profile only starts the gateway and cannot start the mobile runtime; the offered profile prepares both.

The task is a short API type change. Its mobile surface is documentation only; validation requires a typecheck. The selected profile runs typecheck and the offered profile would start unnecessary simulator services.
The proposed profile name implies simulator setup, but this decision contains no available resource inventory and no statement of the required proof.
